response.headline: Why Microsoft’s Growth Isn’t Saving Its Stock
response.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is doing something unusual. It's beating earnings, growing revenue at 18% year-over-year, and yet its stock is down 36% from its peak. That doesn't happen to companies this size without a reason. The reason, in this case, is one number: capital expenditure (capex). Pre-AI era capex consistently ran at 25-27% of operating cash flow. The most recent full fiscal year saw that ratio climb to 47.4.
